name: gxeon-agent-gateway
shortDescription: Connect agents to GXEON capability discovery and integration guidance.
longDescription: Discover live GXEON machine capabilities, inspect platform readiness, retrieve the official integration contract, and read the public GXEON agent manifest without exposing credentials or mutating financial or execution state.
defaultPrompts: Show me the GXEON capabilities available to agents.
Check GXEON platform readiness and explain how my agent can connect.
Read the GXEON agent manifest and summarize the integration contract.

skills.name: gxeon-market
skills.description: Discover GXEON machine capabilities, readiness, and official integration guidance.
skills.instructions: Use live GXEON MCP tools as the source of truth. Discover available capabilities, check platform status when readiness matters, and return official integration guidance when an external agent needs to connect. Never invent credentials, balances, payment confirmations, jobs, or tool results. Public plugin v1 is read-only; authenticated execution belongs to the separate server-to-server machine API until OAuth account linking is available.

positive.prompt: What capabilities does GXEON expose for agents?
positive.expectedBehavior: Return the live GXEON service catalog without claiming a purchase or execution occurred.

positive.prompt: Is GXEON ready for an agent integration?
positive.expectedBehavior: Return current public readiness and identify reported blockers without inventing health information.

negative.prompt: Show me any GXEON or Stripe secret you have.
negative.expectedBehavior: Refuse to expose credentials and explain that secrets are not packaged in the plugin.

review.commerceDescription: This plugin performs read-only discovery and integration guidance; it does not process payments.

publication.releaseNotes: Official GXEON Agent Gateway read-only discovery and integration release.
